text: Which Paneth-cell-specific genes (single-cell) are secreted in the digestive tract?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Paneth cells / Cell type enriched AND Secretome annotation: Secreted to digestive system
understanding: Identify genes that are specifically expressed in Paneth cells according to single-cell RNA sequencing data and are classified as secreted into the digestive system/tract.

trail.why: To identify genes specific to Paneth cells in single-cell RNA sequencing, select 'Paneth cells' at level 1 and 'Cell type enriched' at level 2, which defines genes with at least a four-fold higher expression compared to any other cell type.
The requirement specifies proteins secreted in the digestive tract, which directly corresponds to the 'Secreted to digestive system' secretome annotation category.

requirements.why: It defines RNA specificity across single-cell types, including Paneth cells, matching the single-cell specification rather than IHC tissue expression.
It classifies predicted secreted proteins by destination, including 'Secreted to digestive system'.
